github_surges.description: An agent skill for creating detailed, interactive isometric illustrations of real-world machines and complex systems. Generates polished SVGs with optional WebGL shaders and 3D effects.
Let an AI model use a real iPhone with a $7 ESP32: AirPlay eyes, USB HID hands, any OpenAI-compatible vision model. No Mac, no developer account, no jailbreak.
AI 自主渗透测试系统 | 百度“agent+”攻防挑战赛冠军项目 Autumn-27/ARTEX
AI 自主渗透测试系统 | 百度“agent+”攻防挑战赛冠军项目
Eleven free Claude skills that test a business before you launch it: a board trained on Hormozi, Thiel and Jobs, a marketing director, a CFO, and a consumer panel of 100 buyer agents. Free, MIT.
Turn world-model imagination into corrective training data for robot policies — a single-GPU, falsifiable pipeline (SmolVLA · LIBERO · CEM · paired simulator replays).

Your personal AI agent in your own Cloudflare account. Chat, memory, tasks, notes and scheduled reminders, deployed with one command: npx create-talorys@latest. Free-tier friendly, single-user, no telemetry.
麦麦省钱助手 —— 基于麦当劳 MCP 的点餐成本优化 Skill。算出当前门店最省钱的点餐方案，并主动提示凑单陷阱。
Let your AI agents paint big arrows, boxes and text on your Mac screen. One CLI, click-through, gone by itself. Skill for Claude Code and Codex. MIT.

一句话让 AI 帮你做产品宣传片！把产品名或网址告诉 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程工具，它会自己调研产品、画出多种风格样图让你挑选、截取 4K 真实页面、按音乐节拍卡点剪辑、生成 AI 旁白并逐句转写校验、自动审图，最后交付一支 4K 商业宣传视频和可在线播放的网页版。App、网站、SaaS、开源项目、课程、AI 模型都能做，你只需确认需求、试听配乐。不用学剪辑软件，也不用花钱找外包。基于 Remotion + ElevenLabs，可直接克隆使用，也能一键安装为 Agent Skill。
